literal: As the way of conduct, let one adopt, in one's own mind, the nature of not having envy.
translation: Let a person adopt as their very rule of conduct the state of mind that is entirely free from envy.
modern: ஒருவன் தன் நெஞ்சத்தில் பொறாமை இல்லாத குணத்தையே தன் ஒழுக்க நெறியாகக் கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet teaches that the most fundamental rule of conduct a person can practice is keeping their mind free from envy. The word 'ஒழுக்காறு' refers to the path of righteous conduct, which is elevated here to mean a core life principle. By advising us to 'adopt' (கொள்க) this envy-free nature (இயல்பு) within our own heart (நெஞ்சத்து), the poet emphasizes that true virtue is an internal state of being. Eliminating jealousy from the mind is thus presented as the primary step toward a moral life.
